title: Strainers.
officialText:
Roof drains shall have strainers extending not less than 4 inches (102 mm) above the surface of the roof
immediately adjacent to the roof drain. Strainers shall have an available inlet area, above roof level, of not less than one and one-half
times the area of the conductor or leader to which the drain is connected.
